008package paint.shared.config;
009
010import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;
011import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
012
013import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
014
015/**
016 * Holds configuration parameters used during the “generate squares” phase of the
017 * system. Values are loaded from a configuration file or preferences store, and
018 * if missing, sensible defaults are applied.
019 */
020public class GenerateSquaresConfig {
021
022    private final int     numberOfSquaresInRecording;
023    private final int     gridSize;
024    private final int     minTracksToCalculate;
025    private final int     minTracksToCalculateTau;
026    private final double  minRequiredRSquared;
027    private final double  minRequiredDensityRatio;
028    private final double  maxAllowableVariability;
029    private final String  neighbourMode;
030    private final boolean tauFittingPlots;
031    private final boolean backgroundPlots;
032
033
034    /**
035     * Constructs a GenerateSquaresConfig by reading appropriate keys from the
036     * {@link PaintConfig} under section GENERATE_SQUARES. If a
037     * value is missing, a default is applied:
038     * <ul>
039     *   <li>numberOfSquaresInRecording: 400</li>
040     *   <li>minTracksToCalculateTau: 20</li>
041     *   <li>minRequiredRSquared: 0.1</li>
042     *   <li>minRequiredDensityRatio: 0.1</li>
043     *   <li>maxAllowableVariability: 10.0</li>
044     *   <li>neighbourMode: "Free"</li>
045     * </ul>
046     */
047    public GenerateSquaresConfig() {
048        
049        this.numberOfSquaresInRecording  = PaintConfig.getInt(    GENERATE_SQUARES, NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING,  400);
050        this.minTracksToCalculate        = PaintConfig.getInt(    GENERATE_SQUARES, MIN_TRACKS_TO_CALCULATE,         5);
051        this.minTracksToCalculateTau     = PaintConfig.getInt(    GENERATE_SQUARES, MIN_TRACKS_TO_CALCULATE_TAU,     20);
052        this.minRequiredRSquared         = PaintConfig.getDouble( GENERATE_SQUARES, MIN_REQUIRED_R_SQUARED,          0.1);
053        this.tauFittingPlots             = PaintConfig.getBoolean(GENERATE_SQUARES, TAU_FITTING_PLOTS,               false);
054        this.backgroundPlots             = PaintConfig.getBoolean(GENERATE_SQUARES, BACKGROUND_PLOTS,                false);
055
056        this.gridSize = gridSizeFor(this.numberOfSquaresInRecording);
057
058        if (isWholeScreen()) {
059            // One square covering the whole image. The selection criteria that compare a square
060            // with the rest of the image cannot apply, so they are fixed rather than read.
061            this.minRequiredDensityRatio = WHOLE_SCREEN_MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO;
062            this.maxAllowableVariability = WHOLE_SCREEN_MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY;
063            this.neighbourMode           = WHOLE_SCREEN_NEIGHBOUR_MODE;
064        } else {
065            this.minRequiredDensityRatio = PaintConfig.getDouble( GENERATE_SQUARES, MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO,      2.0);
066            this.maxAllowableVariability = PaintConfig.getDouble( GENERATE_SQUARES, MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY,       10.0);
067            this.neighbourMode           = PaintConfig.getString( GENERATE_SQUARES, NEIGHBOUR_MODE,                  "Free");
068        }
069    }
070
071    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
072    // Whole screen (1x1 grid)
073    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
074
075    /**
076     * Density ratio threshold for a 1x1 grid. With one square, the background is that square
077     * itself, so its density ratio is always 1 and would never pass the normal threshold.
078     */
079    public static final double WHOLE_SCREEN_MIN_REQUIRED_DENSITY_RATIO = 0.0;
080
081    /**
082     * Variability limit for a 1x1 grid: effectively none. Variability is then measured over the
083     * whole image, empty areas included, and is not comparable with that of a normal square.
084     * <p>
085     * A large finite value rather than infinity: the value is stamped into Recordings.csv, and
086     * the CSV writer formats infinity as "∞", which the reader cannot parse back.
087     */
088    public static final double WHOLE_SCREEN_MAX_ALLOWABLE_VARIABILITY = 1.0E9;
089
090    /**
091     * Neighbour mode for a 1x1 grid. Strict and Relaxed require a selected neighbouring square,
092     * which a single square does not have.
093     */
094    public static final String WHOLE_SCREEN_NEIGHBOUR_MODE = "Free";
095
096    /**
097     * Whether the grid is 1x1: one square covering the whole image, giving a Tau over all tracks.
098     * In that case {@code Min Required Density Ratio}, {@code Max Allowable Variability} and
099     * {@code Neighbour Mode} are not read from the configuration but fixed to the
100     * {@code WHOLE_SCREEN_*} values.
101     *
102     * @return {@code true} for a 1x1 grid
103     */
104    public boolean isWholeScreen() {
105        return gridSize == 1;
106    }
107
108    /**
109     * Converts a square <em>count</em> into a grid <em>side</em> length — the single definition
110     * of that conversion.
111     * <p>
112     * It previously existed inline at four call sites in two different forms: some truncated with
113     * {@code (int) Math.sqrt(n)}, others rounded with {@code (int) Math.round(Math.sqrt(n))}. The
114     * count always comes from a fixed dropdown (5x5 … 40x40) and so is a perfect square, which is
115     * why the two never disagreed in practice — but there is no reason to keep two formulas around
116     * waiting to.
117     * <p>
118     * A non-perfect square can only come from a hand-edited configuration file. That still yields a
119     * well-defined grid, just a smaller one than was asked for, so this warns rather than fails.
120     *
121     * @param numberOfSquaresInRecording the configured number of squares per recording
122     * @return the number of squares along one side of the grid
123     */
124    public static int gridSizeFor(int numberOfSquaresInRecording) {
125        int side = (int) Math.round(Math.sqrt(numberOfSquaresInRecording));
126        if (side * side != numberOfSquaresInRecording) {
127            PaintLogger.warnf(
128                    "'%s' is %d, which is not a perfect square. Using a %dx%d grid (%d squares).",
129                    NUMBER_OF_SQUARES_IN_RECORDING, numberOfSquaresInRecording, side, side, side * side);
130        }
131        return side;
132    }
133
134    /**
135     * @return total number of squares in a recording grid.
136     */
137    public int getNumberOfSquaresInRecording() {
138        return numberOfSquaresInRecording;
139    }
140
141    /**
142     * The side length of the square grid — i.e. {@code sqrt(numberOfSquaresInRecording)}.
143     * <p>
144     * This is the single place that converts a square <em>count</em> into a grid
145     * <em>side</em>. It used to be recomputed inline at four call sites, and not
146     * consistently: some truncated with {@code (int) Math.sqrt(n)} while others rounded
147     * with {@code (int) Math.round(Math.sqrt(n))}. The count always comes from a fixed
148     * dropdown (5x5 … 40x40) so it is a perfect square and the two agree — but there is
149     * no reason to leave two formulas lying around waiting to disagree.
150     *
151     * @return the number of squares along one side of the grid
152     */
153    public int getGridSize() {
154        return gridSize;
155    }
156
157    /**
158     * @return minimum number of tracks needed for basic calculations.
159     */
160    public int getMinTracksToCalculate() {
161        return minTracksToCalculate;
162    }
163
164    /**
165     * @return minimum track count required to compute a valid Tau value.
166     */
167    public int getMinTracksToCalculateTau() {
168        return minTracksToCalculateTau;
169    }
170
171    /**
172     * @return the threshold for minimum acceptable R² of binding kinetics fits.
173     */
174    public double getMinRequiredRSquared() {
175        return minRequiredRSquared;
176    }
177
178    /**
179     * @return the threshold for minimum density ratio (foreground vs background).
180     */
181    public double getMinRequiredDensityRatio() {
182        return minRequiredDensityRatio;
183    }
184
185    /**
186     * @return the maximum allowed coefficient of variation for selection.
187     */
188    public double getMaxAllowableVariability() {
189        return maxAllowableVariability;
190    }
191
192    /**
193     * @return the active neighbour mode (e.g., "Free", "Strict").
194     */
195    public String getNeighbourMode() {
196        return neighbourMode;
197    }
198
199    /**
200     * @return {@code true} if per-square Tau-fitting plots should be generated (default {@code false}).
201     */
202    public boolean isTauFittingPlots() {
203        return tauFittingPlots;
204    }
205
206    /**
207     * @return {@code true} if background histogram plots should be generated (default {@code false}).
208     */
209    public boolean isBackgroundPlots() {
210        return backgroundPlots;
211    }
212
213    @Override
214    public String toString() {
215
216        return "GenerateSquaresConfig{" +
217                "Number of Squares in Row      = " + numberOfSquaresInRecording +
218                ", Min Tracks To Calculate     = " + minTracksToCalculate +
219                ", Min Tracks To Calculate Tau = " + minTracksToCalculateTau +
220                ", Min Required R Squared      = " + minRequiredRSquared +
221                ", Min Required Density Ratio  = " + minRequiredDensityRatio +
222                ", Max Allowable Variability   = " + maxAllowableVariability +
223                ", Neighbour Mode              = '"+ neighbourMode + '\'' +
224                ", Tau Fitting Plots           = " + tauFittingPlots +
225                ", Background Plots            = " + backgroundPlots +
226                '}';
227    }
228}
